blocks.text: PARIS — France was reeling from widespread destruction after violent protests over the cost of living left streets littered with burned-out cars, smashed shop windows and looted stores. Authorities said about 1,800 people had been arrested nationwide, while hundreds of police officers, firefighters and paramedics were reported hurt. In Paris, protesters built barricades from bicycles, bins and other materials, while masked youths looted shops. The violence also hit other cities, including Marseille, Bordeaux, Nice and Strasbourg. In Limoges, a fire that authorities said was deliberately set destroyed the city’s 19th-century town hall.
